speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
text: asked the Minister for Foreign Affairs (a) what are the benefits and implications of the recent agreement with Malaysia to suspend overlapping claims in Singapore's territorial waters off Tuas; and (b) when was the last occasion that foreign vessels had anchored in Singapore's territorial waters off Tuas.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We hope that the recommendations will be implemented as soon as possible within the agreed timeframe.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Overall, the agreement is a positive and concrete step forward for both countries and is reflective of Singapore’s commitment to resolve our issues with Malaysia in a calm and rational and amicable manner, in accordance with international law, and to nurture this very important bilateral relationship whilst safeguarding our national interests.
